descriptions.notStarted: Apparently, the #bThe Rememberer#k of Sleepywood is conducting studies on mutated Horny Mushrooms. You should go to Sleepywood to find out more.

descriptions.completed: You helped #bThe Rememberer#k with his research on Horny Mushrooms, but he seems to need some more information.
